title: QwenSafe: Multimodal Content Rating Description Identification via Preference-Aligned VLMs
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical identification of content rating descriptors (e.g., violence, sexual content, gambling) for mobile app safety. While it deals with harmful content detection, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, moral reasoning, or ethical systems in the models themselves; rather, it uses them as tools for classification based on predefined marketplace standards.
